result.title: Driver Gaze Target Identification via Gaze Estimation and Structured Driving Scene Understanding
result.summary: Identifying a driver's gaze target provides object-level information for visual attention monitoring in intelligent vehicles. Gaze-zone classification and continuous attention localization provide limited information about the identity of the attended scene target. This paper proposes a modular framework that identifies object- or region-level gaze targets from synchronized in-cabin driver images and forward-view road images. The framework comprises four components: MFGaze, which combines a Vision Transformer pretrained with a masked autoencoder (MAE) and head-pose conditioning through feature-wise linear modulation (FiLM); panoptic scene understanding, which constructs a structured candidate set; polynomial ridge regression, which maps gaze features to 2D scene-image coordinates through individualized calibration; and entropy-driven target inference, which adaptively fuses boundary-distance geometry with class-level semantic priors. Experiments evaluate the framework using three public gaze datasets, a laboratory test using Cityscapes road scenes and self-collected gaze data, and the Look Both Ways (LBW) dataset. The complete framework achieves an overall Top-1 gaze target identification accuracy of 96.27% in the laboratory experiment. After sequence-specific calibration, it achieves Top-1 accuracies of 79.92% for task-relevant objects and 85.58% for the road class on LBW. MFGaze achieves the lowest mean angular errors among the compared methods, with 4.06$^\circ$, 4.23$^\circ$, and 10.52$^\circ$ on MPIIFaceGaze, ETH-XGaze, and Gaze360, respectively, and demonstrates strong cross-dataset generalization. Sensitivity analyses show stable performance under hyperparameter perturbations. These results support the framework as a source of object-level gaze information for driver monitoring.

AI.brief_summary: 该文提出模块化驾驶员注视目标识别框架：以 MAE 预训练 ViT 加 FiLM 头姿条件化估计注视方向，借全景场景理解构建结构化候选集，经个体化多项式岭回归映射到场景坐标，再由熵驱动融合边界几何与类级语义先验定位目标。
AI.relevance_reason: 其结构化候选集与熵驱动几何/语义融合，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选和「该看哪里」的获取决策提供线索，但整体属驾驶感知应用，未涉及推理期 latent 状态，联系需核查。
